main_text.p: chat, quia scriptum Psalm.16. vers.10: Quoniam non derelinques me in inferno, nec dabis pium tuum, ut videat corruptionem. Vocatur Bor Schaon, & Tit haijavcn, quia scriptum Psalm.40.vers.3. Et eduxit me ex puteo strepitus, ex luto cœni. Dicitur Tzalmaveth, quia scriptum Psalm.107.vers.10: Habitantes tenebras & umbram mortis: Vocatur quoque Eretz thachthith.
main_text.head: XIII.
main_text.p: Credunt, homines, tum intermedios, impiosque, tum perfecte improbos, ad infernum omnes descensuros, pœnasque subituros infernales; hanc tamen addentes differentiam, quod intermedii, impiique ex Judæis, tandem post duodecim menses ex hoc carcere sint liberandi & ad vitam perducendi æternam, perfecte vero improbi tum Judæi, tum gentiles, tum Christiani nullam ex inferno liberationis habeant (pem reliquam, nulloque modo ad superas possint evadere auras, uti patet ex Rabbi Leone Mutinensi in Opusculo de Ceremoniis hodiernorum Judæorum, Part. V. cap.10: Quod ad infernum, qui Judæis dicitur ᵴᵴᵴ, sentiunt, impiorum animas igni illic, alisque supplicijs vehementissime excruciari, qua aliæ damnatorum sine spe redemptionis; alij vero ad certum tempus sustinere tenentur. Ad ultimum pœnarum genus optime nomen purgatorij qua-

page.notes: Hebrew words in the text (Bor Schaon, Tit haijavcn, Tzalmaveth, Eretz thachthith, and the Hebrew term after "qui Judæis dicitur") are transliterated as printed in Latin letters; the Hebrew-script term after "dicitur" could not be read reliably. Final line ends with catchword "qua-" printed at foot.
